page.title: Project Context
page.subtitle: Markdown documents discovered from this repository's local clone. Read at review time as untrusted context — never stored or edited here.
page.usage: Used by {count, plural, one {# agent} other {# agents}}
page.footer: {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} · ≈{tokens} tokens · refreshed {time}
page.readerEmpty: Select a document to read it.

noClone.title: No local clone yet
noClone.body: Import or sync this repository first — documents are read from its local clone.

empty.title: No markdown documents found
empty.body: No .md files were found under the configured roots. Add documents to the repository itself (e.g. under specs/, docs/, insights/) and re-scan.

picker.orderHint: Order matters — earlier documents appear earlier in the “## Project context” block. Tick to attach; drag or use the arrows to reorder.
picker.missingHint: Attached but not currently discovered — uncheck to remove it from the set.
picker.footerNoteAgent: The attached set is injected as an untrusted “## Project context” block into every run of this agent for the selected repo.
picker.footerNoteSkill: The attached set is injected as an untrusted “## Project context” block into every run of an agent using this skill for the selected repo.
picker.skillInheritanceNote: Any agent using this skill inherits these documents for the selected repo (merged after the agent's own set, deduplicated by path).
picker.noClone: Import or sync this repository first — documents are read from its local clone.
picker.emptyCloned: No markdown documents discovered under the configured roots. Add them to the repository itself, then re-scan from the Project Context page.
